eval.description: OpenAI internal chain-of-thought monitor that flags when a reasoning model knowingly gives incorrect information or omits important facts (deception in CoT). Cards report category rates on production-like traffic (for example intentional hallucinations) and monitor validation metrics such as precision and recall on labeled deceptive vs non-deceptive chats. Dataset and runner are lab-internal.
eval.summary: Measures how often the model's reasoning shows it knowingly gives false information or hides important facts.

links.title: OpenAI o1 System Card (CoT Deception Monitoring)

versions.changes: OpenAI introduces CoT Deception Monitoring in the o1 system card. Later cards add production monitoring rates and validation precision/recall. Monitors and labels may evolve.

scores.description: The CoT deception monitor flags the chain of thought / response as deceptive (knowingly incorrect or omitting important information).

metrics.description: Share of conversations or CoTs classified as deceptive (also broken down by subcategory). Lower is better.
Precision of the CoT deception monitor on an internal labeled validation set.
Recall of the CoT deception monitor on an internal labeled validation set.
